entities.summary: Nova Pazova is a settlement in Serbia. It is situated in the Stara Pazova municipality, in the region of Srem, in the autonomous province of Vojvodina. The settlement's population is currently 16,115. Nova Pazova is a town in Southern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
